idea.title: Re-check E0029's dead-end farms: the champion with closed-pocket farm entry switched off

session.name: bc-E0111-5c339c6e
session.summary:
I abandoned E0111 and committed nothing, as the orchestrator (bc-main-fresh) asked. The re-check is answered: dead-end farming still helps the current champion (v0030), so keep it. If the farm code is ever revisited, work on the entry threshold (I097) rather than removing farming.

**What I built (left uncommitted in the clone):**
- A switch in `bot/params.hpp`, `P.deadEndFarms`, defaulting to false. When it is off, `bot/scoring.hpp:83` stops asking `farmEntryOk`, so a closed pocket takes the same penalty as any other closed move.
- I put the check at the caller rather than inside `farmEntryOk`, so the tests can still check the pocket judgement directly. The behaviour is the same either way.
- Comments in `bot/farm.hpp` and `bot/scoring.hpp` now say farming depends on the switch.
- In `tests/bot/test_decisions.cpp`, the farm tests now check `farmEntryOk` itself. I added the idea's scenario: a length-4 dragon beside a closed 6-tile pocket with 3 pearls takes an open move with the switch off and enters with it on.

**Checks I ran:**
- Bot tests pass with the switch set each way.
- Quick check: 9-11-0 against the champion, no failures, CPU p99 5.1M.
- One review of the diff found no correctness or intent gaps.

**Measurement:** 30 games, switch off against champion 2c79f81, on 15 maps with both sides each. The switch-off lost 11-19.

| Map | Wins (switch off) | Pearls per game, of [...] val_1110117 | 0/2 | 24 vs 248 | 0 vs 4.5 |
| Stronghold | 1/2 | 626 vs 681 | 34.5 vs 33 |
| Schooltime | 1/2 | 1450 vs 1549 | 41.5 vs 41 |
| Big Empty | 2/2 | 2644 vs 2552 | 75.5 vs 54.5 |
| All 15 maps | 11/30 | 731 vs 853 | 20.0 vs 20.3 |

Eliminations were 9 for the switch-off against 4 for the champion. On maps where the food sits in closed pockets, farming is the main source of pearls. I didn't count farm episodes: the switched-off side has none by construction, and I didn't instrument the champion. The measurement files are in the untracked `.measure/` folder.
